issue.title: Salvage and land the verified -p display-name resolution fix (sase-zo)
issue.description: salvage-display-name: sase repo list/log/open/path -p still resolves the project token as a directory key only, so `sase repo list -p sase` exits 2 on master (+10 corroboration). The complete, verified fix — registry-canonicalized -p accepting key, display name, or alias, with regression tests — sits uncommitted in the sase_21 workspace clone on athena (base 99932634cd). Salvage that diff, rebase it onto current master, re-run its tests, and land it before workspace retention reclaims the state.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/next_seven_salvage_and_unstrand.md defines phase salvage-display-name as one work unit

issue.title: Stop runner module imports from replacing the process SIGTERM handler (sase-1s2)
issue.description: sigterm-import: importing sase.axe.run_agent_runner (line 87) or sase.axe.mentor_runner (line 30) installs a soft SIGTERM handler at import time, replacing the caller's handler in every importer (pytest workers, tool runs). Move the install into the runner-owned entry lifecycle, keeping production shutdown semantics, and add fresh-interpreter import plus real-entry signal tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/next_seven_salvage_and_unstrand.md defines phase sigterm-import as one work unit

issue.title: Stop done monitors with stale followup_pending from owning beads forever (sase-1re)
issue.description: monitor-ownership: a monitor member that is done but still reports followup_pending=true (stale next_action, no followup_outcome) reduces to owned/monitor in sase-core stranded_work/classify.rs owner_kind() forever, hiding the bead from STRANDED and the recovery reconciler. Root-cause why the follow-up never settled, then bound ownership using actual delivery/recovery facts, distinguishing a dead abandoned follow-up from a queued successor, a live monitor, and settlement grace. Needs a sase-core change and pin move.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/next_seven_salvage_and_unstrand.md defines phase monitor-ownership as one work unit

issue.title: Stop continuation capture from nesting fork ancestry past the 256 KiB cap (sase-1o1)
issue.description: continuation-capture: persist_agent_delta records the #fork-expanded step prompt as authored_local_request and replay renders it as the parent user block, so every session member re-nests its whole ancestry; a live athena land session is at 708,391 bytes against the 262,144-byte validator cap, and an over-cap turn fails capture and settles the next monitor follow-up not-launchable. Capture only the local pre-fork request, make replay walk the parent chain, keep fork-replay output byte-stable, and add a repair or explicit error for in-flight over-cap sessions. Needs sase-core and sase changes.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/next_seven_salvage_and_unstrand.md defines phase continuation-capture as one work unit

issue.title: Stop host completion from refusing checks that passed (sase-1qm)
issue.description: fingerprint-refusal: prepared completions backed by a fully green just check are refused with stale_worktree_fingerprint even when every observed fingerprint matches on hand audit (5 refusals in October, 11 so far in November; fresh sase recurrences 11-07 and 11-10). Diff the sealed observation against the host-time observation for the fresh repro runs (suspect: cross-repo scope over main plus sase-core), fix the confirmed mechanism, and make every refusal record name which fingerprint component differed. Needs sase-core and sase changes.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/next_seven_salvage_and_unstrand.md defines phase fingerprint-refusal as one work unit

issue.title: Make sase agent restart find crash-killed agents (sase-1qi, ride-along sase-1qr)
issue.description: agent-identity: a kill or reboot that never writes done.json leaves the TUI showing FAILED while sase agent restart returns not-found, because find_named_agent skips non-done records with dead PIDs (correct for wait resolution, wrong for restart). Give restart a lookup that includes dead-without-done records without deleting the liveness skip waiters rely on. Ride-along per decision qr_ride_along: project process_identity through the sase-core agent scan so the PID-reuse guard stops degrading to PID-only for scanned records.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/next_seven_salvage_and_unstrand.md defines phase agent-identity as one work unit

issue.title: Verify an existing attachments-private remote is actually private before pushing (sase-1db)
issue.description: private-remote-verify: preflight_sidecars compares visibility only when creating a missing attachments-private remote; an existing remote is trusted on its configured role alone and describe_label hard-codes "(private)", so attachment bytes can be pushed to a public repository under a private label. Probe visibility for existing remotes with resolve_remote_visibility at repo-init preflight and at the shared write boundary before the first upload per process, define honest unknown-visibility handling, and stop hard-coding the label.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/next_seven_salvage_and_unstrand.md defines phase private-remote-verify as one work unit
